places.name: Hoi An Ancient Town
places.ai_summary: A UNESCO World Heritage site featuring well-preserved buildings, lantern-lit streets, and a blend of Vietnamese, Chinese, and Japanese influences.

opening_hours.notes: Lantern festival occurs on the 14th day of each lunar month.

places.place_tip: Visit during the lantern festival for a magical experience.
places.address: Hoi An Ancient Town, Quang Nam, Vietnam
